full_judgment: The plaintiffs-appellants instituted Title Suit No.253 of 1983 before the Court of learned Assistant Judge, Sadar, Lakshmipur, praying for decree for declaration of title in the suit land measuring an area of 2.44 acres stating, inter alia, that the suit land of DS Khatian No.126 of Romapur Mouza belonged to Muzaffar Ahmed and others. In four annas share, Muzaffar Ahmed was the owner of 991/2 decimals of land and he sold 73 decimals of land to the plaintiff No.1 by a registered deed of sale dated 28-1-1959. Maqbul Ahmed, the heir of Sirajul Haque, in four annas share, sold 21 decimals of land to the plaintiff No.1 by a registered deed of sale dated 2-1-1963. Jobedullah one of the heirs of recorded co-sharer Idris Mia sold 21 decimals of land to the plaintiff N6.1 by a registered deed of sale dated 31-1-1959. In Plot No.743 of the said Khatian, one Abdul Jalil was the owner of 56 decimals of land by purchase which was acquired by Ayesha by transfer. She was also the owner of 20 decimals of land in Plot No.663 and 73 decimals of land in Plot No.738. Ayesha sold 1.29 acres of land to Jayeda Khatun by different deeds of sale and Jayeda Khatun in her life time sold 1.29 acres of land to the plaintiff No.2 by a registered deed of sale dated 26-2-1959. Thus, the plaintiff Nos.1 and 2 have been owning and possessing 1.15 and 1.29 acres of land respectively, in all, 2.44 acres of land in the said khatian. During last diara operation, the suit land was wrongly recorded in the name of the defendant Nos.1-3. As a result, the plaintiffs' title to the suit land has been clouded. Hence, the suit has been filed.
